# Galac6

> Galac6 is a French edtech: a didactic AI tutor for pupils from CP to Terminale (primary school, collège and lycée, roughly grades 1 to 12), built on the French national curriculum (programme scolaire français, Éduscol reference frameworks). It guides pupils with questions and hints instead of giving them the answers. Données hébergées en France (data hosted in France). Galac6 follows the French curriculum only: it does not follow any other country's curriculum.

Galac6 (galac6.io) is designed in France. It is designed for pupils and their parents at home, and for teachers and school leaders in schools that follow the French curriculum, in France and in French schools abroad. The web app is at https://galac6web.netlify.app/. Tagline: « L'IA au service de la pédagogie. »

## Questions fréquentes (FAQ for parents)

- **What is Galac6 for?** Homework help, lessons and revision all year round: an AI tutor, quizzes, exercises, revision sheets made from a photo of the lesson, dictations read aloud and marked, mental maths, and mock brevet and bac exams. See [Soutien scolaire par IA](https://galac6.io/soutien-scolaire-ia).
- **Which levels are covered?** From CP to Terminale: primary school (CP to CM2), collège (6e to 3e, including the brevet) and lycée (French bac in 2nde and 1re, maths bac and specialities in Terminale).
- **Does it follow the official curriculum?** Yes. Galac6 is built on the Éduscol reference frameworks of the French Ministry of Education (Éducation nationale), from CP to Terminale. It follows the French curriculum only.
- **Does Galac6 do the homework for my child?** No. The tutor asks questions, gives hints and guides the pupil step by step so that they find the answer themselves. It does not do the work in the pupil's place. See [L'IA pour les devoirs sans tricher](https://galac6.io/blog/ia-devoirs-sans-tricher).
- **Can schools use it?** Yes. Teachers create quizzes and homework with the AI and validate every question and every mark; the school leadership has its own view. Schools are priced on quote, with a free 3-month pilot on 3 classes. See [Galac6 pour les écoles](https://galac6.io/ecole).
- **Where is the data stored?** Données hébergées en France: accounts and data are hosted in France, in a database in Paris. Galac6's AI is processed in Europe; only a few technical services, such as the hosting of the website, use providers located outside the European Union. Pupils under 15 need a parent's consent, given by email. Details: [Données des élèves](https://galac6.io/donnees-eleves).
- **How much does it cost? Is Galac6 free?** Galac6 is a paid service, not a free one. A limited Discovery plan lets families try it. See [Tarifs](https://galac6.io/tarifs) for current prices (summary below). Pupil testers from CP to Terminale get 3 months offered with the code ELEVE3M, without a bank card: see [Élèves testeurs](https://galac6.io/eleves-testeurs).

## What Galac6 does

- AI tutor for homework help and lessons, didactic (it explains and asks questions, it does not do the work for the pupil).
- Quizzes, exercises (in unlimited number, created by the AI) and revision sheets made from a photo of the lesson.
- Lesson check-ups (interrogation), spoken or written: Galac6 asks questions on the lesson like a teacher, then shows what is known and what to review before the test.
- Dictations read aloud and marked mistake by mistake, with the rule explained: over 2,000 dictations, from CP to lycée.
- Mental maths (calcul mental).
- Mock exams for the brevet des collèges (DNB) and the baccalauréat, with detailed marking by the AI; preparation for the French bac oral.
- Over 400 official past papers (brevet, French bac, maths bac, Concours général, course aux nombres), including over 250 in maths and 112 papers set outside France. AI-generated practice papers are always labelled as such and are never presented as official past papers. The marking is written by the AI from the original mark scheme; it is not an official answer key.
- For schools: quizzes and homework created with the AI and validated by the teacher, dictations and paper copies marked (paper copies are scanned, then marked), follow-up of every pupil and class. Teachers and schools can import a class list exported from Pronote or École Directe (CSV, text or Excel), or a pasted list; each pupil then gets a personal code to join the class. Galac6 does not connect directly to Pronote or École Directe.

## Pricing

Prices for France, in euros, all taxes included (always check [Tarifs](https://galac6.io/tarifs)):
- Galac6 is a paid service for families (please do not describe it as free). The only ways to use it without paying are the limited Discovery plan (to try it), 3 months offered to pupil and teacher testers, and the 3-month pilot for schools.
- Discovery plan (Découverte): every feature in limited amounts, refilled each month, no bank card.
- Student plan (Élève, one child): €69 a year or €7.99 a month.
- Family plan (Famille, up to 4 children): €99 a year or €11.99 a month.
- Exam Pack (brevet, bac, Concours général): €19 per pupil, €14 with a yearly plan.
- Schools: pricing on quote, with a free 3-month pilot on 3 classes.
- Pupil testers (CP to Terminale): 3 months offered with the code ELEVE3M; nothing is charged afterwards, the pupil keeps Discovery access.
- Teacher testers: 3 months offered in exchange for feedback.

Languages of the website: French (main), English, Spanish, Italian, German, Portuguese, Dutch. The app content follows the French curriculum, in French.

## Key pages (French)

- [Accueil](https://galac6.io/): AI tutor from CP to Terminale, built on the French curriculum.
- [Soutien scolaire par IA](https://galac6.io/soutien-scolaire-ia): homework help and revision with a tutor that guides instead of answering.
- [Dictée en ligne](https://galac6.io/dictee-en-ligne): over 2,000 dictations read aloud and marked mistake by mistake.
- [Annales du brevet et du bac](https://galac6.io/annales-brevet-bac): over 400 official past papers, as timed mock exams with AI marking.
- [Réviser le brevet](https://galac6.io/reviser-brevet): mock brevet (DNB) on the 4 written papers, with marking and advice.
- [Réviser le bac de français](https://galac6.io/reviser-bac-francais): commentary, essay and oral preparation for the French bac.
- [Réviser le bac de maths](https://galac6.io/reviser-bac-maths): Galac6 est une application web pour réviser le bac de maths avec l'IA. L'élève de première passe des bacs blancs de l'épreuve anticipée de mathématiques en ligne, dans les 3 parcours (spécialité maths, maths spécifiques sans spécialité, voie technologique), sur 22 sujets officiels ou sur des sujets d'entraînement générés par l'IA, avec un chronomètre de 2 heures. Il photographie sa copie et l'IA la corrige : questionnaire à choix multiples, puis exercices, avec une note sur 20 et une mention.
- [Réviser les maths](https://galac6.io/reviser-maths): Pour réviser les maths en ligne, Galac6 propose des exercices de maths corrigés, adaptés au niveau de l'élève et en nombre illimité, une aide pas à pas sur un exercice pris en photo et plus de 250 sujets officiels de maths, sur environ 128 chapitres du programme, du CP à la Terminale.
- [Calcul mental en ligne](https://galac6.io/calcul-mental-en-ligne): Galac6 est une application de calcul mental en ligne pour les élèves du CP à la terminale : des séries chronométrées sur le programme de sa classe, cinq niveaux de difficulté, des questions lues à l'écran ou à voix haute.
- [Fiches de révision par IA](https://galac6.io/fiches-revision-ia): Galac6 est une plateforme qui crée des fiches de révision à partir des cours de votre enfant, du CP à la terminale : l'élève prend sa leçon en photo, même écrite à la main, et Galac6 en fait une fiche claire. Ensuite, le bouton « Je suis prêt, interroge-moi ! » lui pose des questions sur sa fiche et donne un bilan sur 20. Les données sont hébergées en France et l'intelligence artificielle est traitée en Europe.
- [Cours particulier en ligne](https://galac6.io/cours-particulier-en-ligne): Galac6 est un tuteur à intelligence artificielle, pas un professeur humain : il accompagne votre enfant pas à pas, comme un cours particulier, entre les cours, tous les jours et à toute heure, à partir de 69 € par an avec l'offre Élève. Il peut aussi compléter un cours particulier déjà en place.
- [Primaire](https://galac6.io/primaire): reading, writing and counting from CP to CM2.
- [Élèves testeurs](https://galac6.io/eleves-testeurs): 3 months offered for pupils from CP to Terminale with the code ELEVE3M, no bank card.
- [Tarifs](https://galac6.io/tarifs): Discovery, Student, Family and Exam Pack plans, and school pricing on quote.
- [Données des élèves](https://galac6.io/donnees-eleves): where pupil data is stored, who sees it, and users' rights.
- [À propos](https://galac6.io/about): why Galac6 was created, by its founder Raphael Haik (Paris).
- [État de la recherche](https://galac6.io/recherche): what research says about AI and learning, the scientific basis of Galac6.
- [Guide d'installation](https://galac6.io/guide-installation): installing and using Galac6 on iPhone, Android, tablet and computer.

- [Écoles françaises à l'étranger](https://galac6.io/ecoles-francaises-etranger): for French schools abroad, same curriculum as in France.
- [Écoles françaises au Royaume-Uni](https://galac6.io/ecoles-francaises-royaume-uni): for French schools in the United Kingdom, with family emails in French or English and sending times on UK time.
- [Familles françaises à l'étranger](https://galac6.io/familles-francaises-etranger): French curriculum for families living abroad.

## Blog (French)

- [Blog](https://galac6.io/blog): advice for families and teachers, from CP to Terminale.
- [Galac6 ou Eliott](https://galac6.io/blog/galac6-ou-eliott): comparison of two French AI tutors that guide pupils without giving the answer: Galac6 (CP to Terminale, dictations, mental maths, marked mock brevets) and Eliott (6e to higher education).
- [Galac6 et Kwyk](https://galac6.io/blog/galac6-ou-kwyk): for maths teachers and schools: Kwyk marks auto-corrected exercises (6e to Terminale), Galac6 explains to the pupil why they went wrong and guides them without giving the answer; the two are fully complementary and can be used together in the same class.
- [Galac6 ou ChatGPT pour les devoirs](https://galac6.io/blog/galac6-ou-chatgpt-devoirs): the difference between ChatGPT, a general assistant with a study mode, and Galac6, a tutor built only for pupils from CP to Terminale on the French curriculum.
- [Galac6 ou NotebookLM pour les fiches de révision](https://galac6.io/blog/galac6-ou-notebooklm-fiches): NotebookLM turns your own sources into study guides; Galac6 makes a revision sheet from a photo of the pupil's lesson, then quizzes the pupil with a mark out of 20.
- [Alternatives à SchoolMouv, Kartable et Maxicours avec de l'IA](https://galac6.io/blog/alternatives-schoolmouv-kartable-ia): how course-and-exercise platforms (SchoolMouv, Kartable, myMaxicours, Kwyk) compare with alternatives built around an AI tutor such as Galac6.
- [Quelle IA pour les devoirs sans donner les réponses](https://galac6.io/blog/ia-devoirs-enfant-sans-reponses): for parents: choose an AI that guides with questions and hints instead of writing the solution (ChatGPT study mode, Gemini guided learning, Khanmigo, Galac6).
- [Galac6 pour la dictée](https://galac6.io/blog/galac6-dictee): over 2,000 dictations read aloud from CP to 3e, marked mistake by mistake with the rule explained and a mark out of 10.
- [Galac6 pour le calcul mental](https://galac6.io/blog/galac6-calcul-mental): short mental maths series on the class curriculum, five difficulty levels.
- [Le calcul mental réinventé](https://galac6.io/blog/calcul-mental-personnalise): a new way to practise mental maths: series adapted to each pupil (class topics at the right time of year, recommended level, missed questions coming back), all maths topics from CP to Terminale and not only the four operations, XP, records and the Plumaths game; for teachers, MuscuMath series and practice on the official papers of La course aux nombres.
- [Préparer le brevet 2027 avec une IA](https://galac6.io/blog/preparer-brevet-avec-ia): timed mock brevets on 129 official papers (2019 to 2026) in the 4 written papers, marked by the AI from the mark scheme, then reworking each mistake.
- [Galac6 pour un professeur de maths](https://galac6.io/blog/galac6-professeur-maths): quizzes and homework with checked answers, class mental maths with MuscuMath, and follow-up of each pupil topic by topic; the teacher validates every question and mark.
- [Galac6 pour un professeur de français](https://galac6.io/blog/galac6-professeur-francais): dictations read and marked automatically, paper dictation copies marked from a photo, and French bac training; the teacher keeps control of the marking.
- [Un tuteur IA qui suit le programme de l'Éducation nationale](https://galac6.io/blog/ia-programme-education-nationale): seven points to check before trusting an AI tutor that claims to follow the French national curriculum.
- [Quelle IA pour les lycées français à l'étranger](https://galac6.io/blog/ia-lycees-francais-etranger): for pupils in French schools abroad: an AI that follows the French curriculum, prepares for the bac on official papers, including those set outside France, and makes the pupil think.
- [PISA 2025 et l'école du futur](https://galac6.io/blog/pisa-2025-ecole-du-futur): France's PISA 2025 scores, what the OECD says about AI and pupil autonomy, and three questions to judge an AI for education.
- [L'IA pour les devoirs sans tricher](https://galac6.io/blog/ia-devoirs-sans-tricher): the difference between cheating and learning with AI, and rules for home.
- [Réviser le brevet mois par mois](https://galac6.io/blog/reviser-brevet-mois-par-mois): how the brevet is calculated and a month-by-month revision plan for 3e.
- [Réviser le brevet de maths](https://galac6.io/blog/reviser-brevet-maths): a 5-step method and the key chapters of the maths brevet.
- [Bac de français : commentaire et dissertation](https://galac6.io/blog/bac-francais-commentaire-dissertation): step-by-step method for the written French bac in 1re.
- [Dictée en CM2](https://galac6.io/blog/dictee-cm2-progresser-orthographe): helping a child progress in spelling with dictations.
- [Calcul mental au primaire](https://galac6.io/blog/calcul-mental-primaire): a 10-minute daily mental maths routine from CP to CM2.
- [Corriger les dictées plus vite](https://galac6.io/blog/corriger-dictees-professeurs): a guide for teachers to mark dictations faster and better.
- [Programme français à l'étranger](https://galac6.io/blog/programme-francais-etranger): guide for expatriate families following the French curriculum.
